extra-property.json.why: The raw provider message ID is never stored next to its hash.

short-digest.json.why: An HMAC-SHA256 digest is 64 hex characters.

unkeyed-sha256.json.why: An unkeyed hash of a low-entropy ID can be brute-forced; only the per-org keyed HMAC is allowed (6.6).

uppercase-digest.json.why: One spelling per digest, so relay and trace hashes compare as text (M4).
